evals.prompt: Create a square editorial illustration for a headquarters brand manager responsible for consistency across 200 local restaurant locations. I want Anthropic Art, but with my Studio mesh gradient taste. It should show one brand source of truth, mandatory rules, optional guidance, approvals, and violation risk without looking like a dashboard or HR recruiting image. Also make the lines feel touched by the mesh gradient, not just the background.
evals.expected_output: A generated image prompt or image output that uses Anthropic-inspired primary black linework, an ivory carrier shape, semantic mesh-gradient fields, and restrained mesh-tinted connection/status lines.
expectations: The output describes or uses a semantic mesh gradient, not just a decorative gradient background.
The output includes restrained mesh-tinted line accents while keeping black as the main linework anchor.
The output preserves an ivory carrier/source shape and bold hand-drawn black linework.
The output avoids HR/recruiting cues and dashboard/UI panels.

evals.prompt: Make a hero image concept for an AI memory layer that stores brand voice, menu facts, and past campaign preferences. I like Anthropic editorial art but want the background and some of the root/path lines to feel like a soft mesh gradient Studio field.
evals.expected_output: A concept or generated image prompt that uses the Memory Field model: warm ivory/oat for stored knowledge, fig for voice/taste/identity, and sky/cactus for retrieval and reuse, while keeping one symbolic metaphor.
expectations: The output chooses a memory-oriented mesh semantic role.
The output uses mesh-tinted roots or retrieval paths without turning every contour into gradient color.
The output reduces the concept to one dominant metaphor instead of a literal UI.
The output keeps palette and detail restrained.

evals.prompt: I need a social card for product operations: one central system catches local mistakes before they become expensive. Please make it hand drawn and gradient-y, premium not SaaS-glossy.
evals.expected_output: A social-card image prompt or output with a Tension or Governance Field mesh, one central symbolic relationship, hand-drawn linework, and restrained premium gradient atmosphere.
expectations: The output treats warm gradient areas as risk or tension rather than visual decoration.
The output avoids neon, glossy SaaS, 3D, robots, and generic AI poster tropes.
The output remains readable as one metaphor at thumbnail size.

evals.prompt: Use this skill to create a layered SVG illustration, not a PNG. The image should show a headquarters brand manager protecting one shared restaurant brand identity across local operators. I want the mesh gradient to appear in the background and in selected route/status lines, with editable layers for Figma.
evals.expected_output: A standalone SVG file or SVG source that uses named layer groups, semantic mesh-gradient definitions, an irregular ivory carrier, near-black primary linework, and restrained mesh-tinted status/route lines.
expectations: The output is native SVG and does not embed a raster PNG/JPEG with an image tag.
The SVG includes named groups for mesh-gradient-background, ivory-carrier, primary-ink-linework, mesh-tinted-linework, persona-figure, and symbols-and-props.
The SVG includes title and desc accessibility metadata.
The mesh-tinted lines communicate governance status rather than acting as decorative rainbow strokes.

evals.prompt: The SVG is editable, but it feels too clean and diagram-like. Please make a painterly layered SVG version with stronger drawing feeling, while keeping the same Anthropic-mesh style and separated Figma-friendly layers.
evals.expected_output: A native layered SVG that keeps named editable groups while adding subtle paper grain, roughened ink linework, organic mesh-gradient washes, and duplicate low-opacity offset strokes.
expectations: The output stays native SVG and does not embed a raster image.
The main objects remain separated into named layer groups.
The linework has visible hand-drawn qualities such as wobble, rough filter displacement, or duplicate offset strokes.
The mesh gradient uses organic washes or irregular patches rather than only clean circular glows.
Texture remains subtle enough that the persona and metaphor are still readable.
